newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha stays easy in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha stays easy in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices stayed easy in quiet trade on Tuesday with soft crude leaving the market to take up the baton from last week's weaker trend, traders said.
However, they said tighter Mediterranean supplies and interest to ship product to the Far East were underpinning the market against slack demand in NWE.
NWE cargoes were notionally assessed at $175/$178 cif.

Demand for heavier naphthenic and aromatic (N+A) material to make gasoline remained thin with refiners running sufficient gasoline to meet their needs as gasoline demand remains below normal for the time of year.
